title: SAC metadata string stored without a UTF-8 check on a best-effort enrichment path, since removed (accepted site)

entries.observed: XDR103: xdr.ScVal.GetStr() (line 195) carries submitter- or contract-controlled bytes into database field data.Contract.Code without a UTF-8 and NUL check

history.note: Created by xcc findings new from report row lint:github.com/stellar/wallet-backend@79ea2acd:XDR103:internal/services/contract_metadata.go:contractMetadataService.fetchSACMetadataForContract.
Closed with the reason the suppression reviewer recorded.
Reason corrected after the reproduction review: the path is reachable at 79ea2acd; the conclusion holds because the enrichment is best-effort and its failure keeps the defaults.

resolution.reason: Not a defect at the reported site, for a reason other than the one first recorded. At 79ea2acd (and 6e5a5910), both before PR #695 (22660cf4), the path is reachable: ingest_live.go:330 calls EnrichStaleSACMetadata at startup and checkpoint.go:382 calls FetchSACMetadata after a checkpoint load. It is a best-effort enrichment that runs after the load has committed: any error, a database write that refuses the value included, rolls back only the enrichment transaction, is logged ('defaults retained, retried on restart') and ingestion proceeds with the rows' ledger-derived defaults. The reported value therefore cannot halt ingestion or be stored partly; the worst outcome is a row that keeps its defaults. PR #695 made the path unreachable and PR #723 (ce332e70) removed it; the site is absent at the pinned current commit e967ce8b.
resolution.manifest_action: none: the linter report stays suppressed with this record as its finding
